statistical_pre_registration.multiplicity_policy: Bonferroni-Holm step-down across primary and secondary endpoints
statistical_pre_registration.scenario_stratification: Balanced allocation across Q1-Q6 (>= 6 pairs per family in 40-pair battery)

compact_screening.purpose: Exploratory signal verification; cannot confer production qualification pass.

extended_screening.purpose: High-confidence directional screening; underpowered for confirmatory standard.

confirmatory_qualification.purpose: Formal qualification decision; achieves >= 80% power at alpha = 0.05.

binding_rule_enforcement: Underpowered screening runs (N < 38 pairs) yielding p >= 0.05 with positive directional effect must be declared QUALIFICATION_INCONCLUSIVE, never QUALIFICATION_PASS.
